title: Move the Falco Events plugin tree to the top level
description:
The libscap event parameter information isn't very useful for plugin
events, so hide it for now and move the plugin tree to the top level.

notes.body:
This changes
![sshark-avec-evt-params](/uploads/6859a784ac41ef4b1e43c13e8d045850/sshark-avec-evt-params.png)
to
![sshark-sans-evt-params](/uploads/428b761021df00cca2d1d34be581a99d/sshark-sans-evt-params.png)
It doesn't seem like the libscap event parameters are very useful when you're analyzing plugin events so I'd like to try omitting them.
